title: Lightning Ghasts
description: Adds two new ghasts, Electro and Nimble ghasts! One will help you in battle, and the other on your journey!
body:
![Lightning Ghasts](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3adee31cc951c9071721475fb5351d1c7a78e5d0.png)

This mod adds a couple of new types of ghasts and a few new items.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/3kwB7Y5C7nM" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# Beta warning
There may be errors and instability.

# Nimble Ghast


<details>
<summary>Show the appearance</summary>

![NimbleGhastImg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18ec209e877a3481d6d2f66623207c7653731d12.png)
![NimbleGhastHarnessImg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba3e571fd64a3ad3ef0295aecc1e1369d6a8ae71.png)

</details>



Can be obtained:

Can only be obtained by using the **Speed ​​effect** on a happy ghast and feeding it **Ghast Treat**. After a while, it will transform into a nimble ghast.

The **Nimble Ghast** itself is faster than the **Happy Ghast**. It can be equipped with a **Speedy Copper Harness**.
Can only carry up to 2 people.

Use a **Giant firework** to attach it to the Ghast's harness. Mount it, hold down the spacebar, and activate the fireworks for a massive speed boost. **(It can hold up to 2 giant fireworks. Caution: if you hit the blocks while accelerating, an explosion will occur and the Ghast will die.)**

# Electro Ghast


<details>
<summary>Show the appearance</summary>
  
![ElectroGhastImg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4075bd4dab0bdc8411043ff92ab2a79e18af2eff_0.webp)

</details>

Rare variant - can be obtained randomly, 1 of 500

You can summon rare variant by using this command : 
```
/summon lightning-ghasts:electro_ghast ~ ~ ~ {rare:1}
```


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![Darker version of ghast](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87ab15f46afadfceb52c2020a1116398706ef93d_0.webp)

</details>

Can be obtained: **Electro Ghast** evolves from **Ghastling** after being struck by lightning at cloud level in any mountain biome.

**Electro Ghast** can be used in combat. Hold down the spacebar for the Ghast to fire an **Electroball**. It will fly in the direction you are looking. If the ball hits an entity, it will give it the **Electric Discharge** status effect.

# Items

**Speed Copper Harness** - It's a simple recipe, but it offers so many possibilities!

![SpeedCopperHarnessRecipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2db269f325e78bdd3f5013a956c857f5c487768e.png)

**Ghast Treat** - It is used to transform a **Happy Ghast** into a **Nimble Ghast**.

![GhastTreatRecipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/326c833472ad47c3d233b8193bfdbe646522fbda.png)

**Giant Firework** - Used to speed up a **Nimble Ghast**.

![GiantFireworkRecipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e118578f892b1d998d97559cbfbdaee6bf4e5b9.png)

**Tears Clot** - can be obtained by killing Ghasts with a 6.25% probability.

![Tears Clot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9aaa89f92b2af22e6417bdfbe4afbf16b978cd4.png)

**Electro Charge** - can be obtained by killing **Electro Ghasts** from 2 to 7.
  Also can be used in **Dispenser Block** (Summoning **Electroball**).
  It can be used on a Creeper, which will then become charged.

![Electroball](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e3d42209cd15fe93add1db4fea3a9552296d46f.gif)

Spawn Eggs - **Electro Ghast**, **Nimble Ghast**

![Spawn Eggs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee766c7393b680538f3ef2bfe41b5ffd91c9499b.png)

# Status Effects

**Electric Discharge** -The entity under the effect takes periodic damage, which increases if the entity is in water or in the rain.

![Electric Discharge Status Effect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/451ddee48152d1f3cd5e686ffa2ef7443db0b215.png)
